task_completion.description: Create a new menu named 'Main Navigation'
task_completion.visual_evidence: In the WordPress 'Menus' screen, the 'Menu Name' field contains 'Main Navigation' and the menu has been saved.

task_completion.description: Add all 7 required items (Home, About Us, Our Products, Cakes, Pastries, Blog, Contact) to the menu
task_completion.visual_evidence: The menu structure list shows all seven items present. 'Home' and 'Our Products' should be labeled as 'Custom Link', others as 'Page'.

task_completion.description: Verify 'Home' links to http://localhost/ and 'Our Products' links to #
task_completion.visual_evidence: In the expanded menu item details, the URL for 'Home' is 'http://localhost/' and the URL for 'Our Products' is '#'.

task_completion.description: Nest 'Cakes' and 'Pastries' as sub-items under 'Our Products'
task_completion.visual_evidence: In the menu structure, 'Cakes' and 'Pastries' are visually indented underneath the 'Our Products' item, labeled as 'sub item'.

task_completion.description: Assign the menu to the 'Primary' menu location
task_completion.visual_evidence: Under 'Menu Settings' at the bottom of the page, the checkbox for 'Primary' (or 'Primary Menu') is checked.
A success message 'Main Navigation has been updated' or the 'Save Menu' button being clicked after all changes are made.

integrity.description: The agent used the WordPress dashboard GUI rather than WP-CLI or direct database manipulation
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the WordPress admin interface and menu builder elements.

integrity.description: The agent selected existing pages from the 'Pages' accordion in the menu editor
integrity.visual_evidence: The 'Pages' tab in the left sidebar of the menu editor is opened and specific pages (About Us, Cakes, etc.) are checked.

integrity.description: The agent did not use the terminal to execute 'wp menu' commands
integrity.visual_evidence: The terminal logs (if visible) do not show menu creation commands; the focus remains on the browser.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The menu must be named exactly 'Main Navigation'. The required items are: Home (Custom Link: http://localhost/), About Us (Page), Our Products (Custom Link: #), Cakes (Page, sub-item of Our Products), Pastries (Page, sub-item of Our Products), Blog (Page), and Contact (Page). The menu must be assigned to the 'Primary' location, which corresponds to the 'primary' key in the Twenty Twenty-One theme.
